title: Pokemon TCG Korean Moltres Scarlet & Violet 146/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Moltres card, numbered 146/165 in the Scarlet & Violet set, is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. The card features a stunning holo finish and is made of high-quality card stock material, ensuring its durability and longevity. 

As a basic stage Pokémon card with the fire attribute, Moltres is a formidable addition to any deck. This card is in Korean language and was manufactured by Nintendo in Japan in 2023. It is suitable for players aged 8 and above and is a holo rare, making it a highly sought-after item. Don't miss your chance to add this beautiful card to your collection!
